# Pre-render

Text from the pre-render

```{r}
warning("This is a warning")
plot(1, 1)
data(iris)
write.table(head(iris), file.path(params$artifact_dir, "iris-head.txt"))
```

```{r export-versions}
versions <- data.frame(
    package = "R",
    version = as.character(getRversion())
)
write.table(
    versions,
    "versions.csv",
    sep       = ",",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE,
    quote     = FALSE
)
```
